text: I'm not really sure if this is anything, I've been up with him most of the night so maybe I'm just seeing things. My grandson is 6, he's got dark skin so it's hard to tell with spots, but I think there's some marks coming up. I couldn't really see on his arms so I looked at the palms of his hands and the bottoms of his feet and pulled his bottom eyelid down a bit like I read somewhere, and there's tiny dark dots there, I think. I pressed a glass on his palm and I'm fairly sure they didn't go away, they were still there under the glass. He's also got one eye that's gone pink and sticky, crusty on the lashes this morning, which might be a separate thing I don't know. I haven't taken his temperature. I'm sorry if this is a lot, I'm just very tired and I'd rather ask than not.
